designationHistory.indexText: Congress passed the act 'to establish the Grays Harbor National Wildlife Refuge' at Bowerman Basin in Washington, protecting a major spring stopover for migrating shorebirds.
designationHistory.note: Signer per the CCP (President Reagan signed August 19, 1988) and the statute date. The CCP says the refuge was actually established with its first parcel in 1990.
